# DINOv3 (subset)

Adapted from DINOv3 ([facebookresearch/dinov3](https://github.com/facebookresearch/dinov3), commit `6876159`): the
modules that `dinov3.hub.backbones._make_dinov3_vit` imports. DoseDiT (`models/dosedit/dosedit_model.py`) builds its two
ViT condition encoders with them.
